metadata.title: Micron Stock Surges Back Toward $1,000. How Far the Memory Chip Titan Could Go.<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
Micron Stock Surges Back Toward $1,000. How Far It Could Go.
Micron Technology stock was surging back toward $1,000 early Friday. Wall Street is confident the memory-chip maker has further to go.
